id: Home Alone 2: Lost in New York (1992)
title: Home Alone 2: Lost in New York
tagline: Room service. Charge it to Dad.
about: Kevin boards the wrong plane and ends up alone at a fancy New York hotel with Dad's credit card.
cue: Order room service when Kevin gets his own suite.
faces: The avenue after a snowstorm, our first winter.
Young guests are most welcome. Every order is charged to the card on file, and I check each one myself. All night.
Chicken, crisp bacon, iceberg, tomato and mayonnaise on toasted white.
Butter-poached tail meat and elbows in Gruyère and cheddar sauce, baked under golden crumbs.
Fried crisp and salted, ketchup on the side.
Any tab over $900 needs a grown-up to sign, in person.
TICK, THEN HANG ON YOUR HANDLE
A park-side suite, dressed for Christmas.
Tomato sauce and plenty of mozzarella, boxed hot for the limousine.
Nuts roasted with rosemary and brown sugar, chocolate almonds and pretzels.
Rolled up: vanilla ice cream, hot fudge, whipped cream, nuts, sprinkles, cherry.
Mulled with cinnamon, cloves and orange.
Whole milk, a heap of marshmallows.
THE PLAZA, Fifth Avenue at the Park
In-room movie tonight: Angels with Even Filthier Souls.
